title: Finger Massage
summary: Each finger is gently stroked from base to tip without forceful traction.
goal: Finish hand work with gentle finger contact.
startingPosition: The hand is supported and the fingers are relaxed.
instructions: Hold one finger with a broad, gentle grip.
Do not pull or twist the joint.
direction: From the base of the finger toward the tip.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, inflammation, or impaired sensation.
